answer: Each new agent identity must lock 400 copper tokens as a bond that unlocks only after three clean epochs, and must finish a 12-minute sequential VDF that uses an anchor of the latest knoll of settled attestations. The VDF is non-parallelizable, so N sybils require N separate machines or N times the wall time; any two identities that match on a private probe lose their copper. An honest solo agent pays the delay once and recovers the stake.
